source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Sure, that’s fine; we can close the contract at this point.

For clarity and to have it on the record, I delivered the first draft on schedule, and it included everything from the original brief. After you said it was difficult to follow, I did not disregard that feedback. Instead, I submitted a second version with substantial revisions that directly addressed it. This included a simplified dashboard, assumptions with clear sources, separate cash flows for both funding scenarios, extra financial statements, and a brief summary presentation to make the review easier. I sent that second deliverable before you asked for this refund. Despite my requests, I received no specific review comments on either the first draft or the second version.

Because both milestones were completed and delivered according to scope, I will not issue a refund. I will take this through Upwork's dispute process to settle the outstanding milestone payment. You may leave whichever review you believe is accurate, and I will do likewise. The delivered work and our message history can speak for themselves.

I’m happy for both sides to conclude this professionally.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that the delivered second version included a brief summary presentation intended to make review easier.

routing_warnings.description: The complaint predates the separate presentation-file commitment and concerns the clarity and understandability of the model's existing presentation rather than the later companion presentation artifact.
